description: Validation test suite for React Data and State Technology Skill rule detection and safe counterpart patterns.

testCases.description: Verify detection of direct in-place mutation of React component state bypassing immutability guarantees.

expected.notes: State array is mutated in place using .push() before passing existing reference to setTasks.
State is copied immutably using array spread syntax producing a fresh reference.

testCases.description: Verify detection of asynchronous fetch inside useEffect lacking cancellation or race condition guards.

expected.notes: useEffect initiates async fetch on userId change without AbortController or active flag.
Fetch request binds to AbortController signal and cancels on effect cleanup.

testCases.description: Verify detection of incomplete query keys omitting reactive filter/sorting dependencies in server-state cache.

expected.notes: useQuery key uses static array omitting reactive query parameters (status, sortBy).
useQuery key includes reactive parameters object { status, sortBy }.

testCases.description: Verify detection of optimistic cache update without rollback snapshot and onError recovery handler.

expected.notes: useMutation updates cache optimistically in onMutate without snapshot return or onError rollback logic.
Previous query data is captured in onMutate context and restored in onError handler.

testCases.description: Verify detection of desynchronized pagination state where active page index is not reset upon filter change.

expected.notes: handleSearchChange modifies search criteria without resetting pagination to initial page index.
handleSearchChange resets pagination page index to 1 when search term changes.
